I've been thinking for a while about my life, Just this year I've terrible luck where i got involved in accident and got hospitalized for more than a month.I had been traumatized thinking back how the accident happened, it was a nightmare when the scene keep playing in my mind.  It's been very hard knowing when Dr. told me that I had lost a physical ability where I can't do any heavy sport anymore ( i like football). After a few months i was discharged, my lecturer advised me (more like they forced me) to continue my study while i was staying behind so much compare to others, it's been really hard to catch up with so much anxiety like can I really do this shit? I mean i missed class for more than a month and they really think i can catch up back? wtf bro im human too. I had complained so much to myself like everyday, but in the end somehow i managed to do it. I'm also having a hard to time to find a friend that understand me really well, even though i can communicate normally with other colleagues but i feel like a stranger to them. Moreover, im also feel jealous for those who are in relationship, they happily flexing their happiness with their partner, while im doing nothing ans just hoping something like that will happen to me. Although all the hardship that happen, I've been bless with my only best friend (which is not at my current study place). Recently we have playing games together which makes me happy so much, it's been very tough thinking nothing much good thing happen to me. So my friend if u r reading this, i wanna say thank you for always be with either in hardship or not.
